beats: This is the AI Readiness Checklist. It checks whether your team, data, tools and guardrails are ready for AI work, and gives you your next three moves.
Name the check, for example by team and month.
Answer twenty-four statements in six areas, for your team as it is today: yes, partly, no, or not sure. Be honest: a no is more useful than a hopeful yes. Fill in an example to see it.
Where you are shows your readiness score and what it means.
The AI adoption journey shows your stage, from starting with you to organization-wide capability, and a score for each area.
Your next three moves come from the gaps in your weakest areas first, with what you said that led to each.
Save it, share a link, or export it, or download the Excel version. Answer it together, act on one move at a time, and re-run it each quarter. That's the tour.
